enriched_activities.desc: Lies on back. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Snores lightly. Opens eyes briefly. Closes eyes. Turns to back. Remains still. Stirs. Opens eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts down toothbrush. Washes face with water. Picks up towel. Dries face. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Greets Member 1. Says good morning. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, milk, butter. Places on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out frying pan. Places on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Uses spatula to stir. Toasts bread in toaster. Pours milk into glasses. Sets plates on table. Calls Member 1 to eat. Sits down. Eats breakfast. Talks with Member 1 about plans. Drinks milk. Finishes eating. Picks up plates. Rinses plates. Places in dishwasher. Wipes table.

enriched_activities.activity: Light tidying and vacuuming of the living areas with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Picks up cushions from floor. Places on sofa. Picks up magazines. Stacks on coffee table. Walks to closet. Opens closet. Takes out vacuum cleaner. Unwinds cord. Plugs into outlet. Turns on vacuum. Pushes vacuum across floor. Moves around furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs cord. Winds cord. Puts vacuum back in closet. Straightens sofa cushions. Dusts TV screen with cloth. Wipes coffee table. Says to Member 1 can you help me move the chair. Member 1 helps. Vacuum behind chair. Thanks Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work at the desk on the computer and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Turns on monitor. Adjusts chair height. Opens illustration software. Picks up stylus. Draws lines on tablet. Presses keyboard shortcuts. Adjusts desk lamp. Zooms in on image. Uses eraser tool. Saves file. Takes a sip of water from glass. Checks phone for messages. Replies to email. Continues drawing. Stretches arms. Stands up. Walks to window. Looks out. Returns to desk. Sits down. Resumes drawing.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning walk around the neighbourhood and coffee at a local cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Grabs jacket. Opens front door. Steps outside. Closes door. Walks down street. Passes houses. Reaches cafe. Opens cafe door. Walks to counter. Orders coffee. Says one coffee please. Pays with card. Receives coffee. Walks to table. Sits down. Sips coffee. Checks phone. Finishes coffee. Throws cup in bin. Exits cafe. Walks back home. Opens front door. Enters. Closes door. Removes shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Washes hands. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lettuce, tomatoes, cheese. Places on counter. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Cuts tomatoes. Cuts cheese. Places bread on plate. Adds lettuce, tomatoes, cheese. Calls Member 1. Says lunch is ready. Member 1 enters. Sits at table. Eats sandwich. Talks with Member 1. Drinks water. Finishes eating. Picks up plates. Rinses plates. Loads dishwasher. Wipes counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing freelance illustration commissions at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens previous file. Picks up stylus. Draws details. Adjusts colors. Uses brush tool. Saves file. Takes a break. Stands up. Stretches. Walks to bathroom. Uses toilet. Returns to desk. Sits down. Continues drawing. Uses phone to take reference photo. Uploads to computer. References photo. Draws more. Saves file. Closes software. Turns off monitor. Turns off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Visiting a local gallery exhibition and browsing an art supply shop
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Grabs bag. Opens front door. Steps outside. Closes door. Walks to gallery. Enters gallery. Looks at paintings. Reads descriptions. Takes notes. Walks to art supply shop. Enters shop. Browses shelves. Picks up sketchbook. Examines paper quality. Picks up set of pencils. Walks to counter. Pays. Exits shop. Walks back home. Opens front door. Enters. Closes door. Removes shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with Member 1, listening to music and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up book. Opens to bookmark. Reads. Turns page. Adjusts sitting position. Puts book down. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Picks up book. Continues reading. Asks Member 1 can you turn up the music. Member 1 adjusts volume. Thanks Member 1. Reads more. Closes book. Leans back. Closes eyes. Listens to music.

Enters kitchen. Washes hands. Opens refrigerator. Takes out chicken, vegetables. Places on counter. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Stirs with spatula. Adds vegetables. Adds spices. Stir. Says to Member 1 can you stir this. Member 1 stirs. Sets table. Places plates. Places utensils. Turns off stove. Serves food onto plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up the dishes with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats food. Talks with Member 1. Drinks water. Finishes eating. Picks up plates. Scrapes leftovers into bin. Rinses plates. Opens dishwasher. Loads plates. Loads utensils. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes table with cloth. Sweeps floor with broom. Puts broom away.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a game on the console with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Browses channels. Selects movie. Watches TV. Talks with Member 1. Picks up game controller. Turns on console. Selects game. Plays game. Presses buttons. Laughs. Pauses game. Gets up. Goes to kitchen. Gets snacks. Returns. Sits down. Resumes game. Plays more. Turns off console. Turns off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Sketching in a sketchbook under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up sketchbook. Opens to blank page. Picks up pencil. Draws outline. Erases mistake. Sharpens pencil. Draws details. Shades with pencil. Turns page. Draws another sketch. Closes sketchbook. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime routine, washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face with cleanser. Rinses face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts toothbrush down. Uses toilet. Flosses teeth. Rinses mouth. Dries face with towel. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.
Enters bedroom. Turns off bedroom light. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Turns to side. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Snores lightly. Turns to back. Remains still.
